subject: CI exception log & PR hardening evidence for SIG intake - Orchid Capital
messages:
From: Laura Benson <laura.benson@orchidcap.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Penwell Assessors <assessor@penwell.com>
Date: 2027-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG intake: targeted SDLC artifacts - PR hardening & CI exceptions

Hi Tessa,

As part of Orchid Capital's SIG intake and our assessor (Penwell) request, we need a focused subset of Secure SDLC evidence related to pull request (PR) hardening and CI exception handling. Can you provide the following artifacts or a secured drive link by EOD 2027-12-22?

1) PR hardening: three representative PRs (sanitized) that show reviewer comments, automated checks, and link to any follow-up ticket if remediation was requested.
2) PR checklist or gating policy (how we enforce security checks pre-merge).
3) CI exception log for the previous quarter (all CI jobs that were marked as "allowed failures" or had temporary bypasses) with rationale and approver.
4) Secrets/credentials rotation evidence for components used by CI (KMS rotation snapshots, audit events).
5) Change management approvals for any emergency/exceptional deploys in the last 6 months.

If some items require redaction, a short note describing redaction scope is fine. Also include a contact (engineer/manager) we can call for clarifying questions during review.

Thanks — appreciate a zipped bundle or a Drive folder with view-only links.

Laura Benson
Senior Information Security Manager, Orchid Capital
laura.benson@orchidcap.com
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Benson <laura.benson@orchidcap.com>, Penwell Assessors <assessor@penwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: targeted SDLC artifacts - PR hardening & CI exceptions

Hi Laura / Penwell team,

Thanks — attaching an initial bundle and a Drive folder with sanitized materials. Brief summary of what's attached:

- pr_security_checklist.pdf — our PR hardening checklist that runs as part of the branch protection rule (static analysis gates, required reviewers, secret-scanning step).
- ci_exception_log_20271215.csv — CI exception entries through 2027-12-15; includes job name, trigger, approver, and short rationale.
- secret_rotation_202711_report.xlsx — KMS/HSM rotation snapshots for CI service keys (redacted key IDs, rotation timestamps).
- change_approval_audit_trail.pdf — tickets and approvals for emergency deploys in last 6 months (redacted internal IDs).
- sample_prs_sanitized.zip — three PR diffs with reviewer comments, automated run results, and remediation follow-ups (sensitive code removed).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gHx-example-drive-link
HubSpot reference: SIG-8372 (Orchid Capital intake)

Notes/assumptions:
- The PR diffs are sanitized to remove proprietary algorithmic snippets; we included reviewer threads and check-run output so you can validate processes.
- CI exception log includes a short "notes" field with approver e-mail; full approver audit events are in the rotation report due to access controls.

If you need additional sample PRs or raw audit events, loop Marissa (engineering lead) and Irene (security engineer) — they've been CC'd. Happy to hop on a quick call if the assessor wants to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG intake: targeted SDLC artifacts - PR hardening & CI exceptions

Marissa / Irene — forwarding Laura's ask and my response. Quick assignments to finish the intake:

- Marissa: please extract the reviewer comment threads from the three PRs and include the lgtm/changes requested sequence plus the corresponding jiras (if any). Preferably in plain text and a small PDF with redaction annotations. Deadline: EOD 2027-12-20.
- Irene: pull the KMS rotation audit events for the CI service principal (last 12 months) and export them to CSV. Include the event timestamps and operator identity. Mask key material and full ARNs before sharing.

Also track a short redaction log so the assessor understands what's been removed. I'll consolidate and push updated files to the Drive folder and notify Laura + Penwell.

Quoted for context:
> From: Laura Benson <laura.benson@orchidcap.com>
> As part of Orchid Capital's SIG intake ...

Thanks — Tessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Benson <laura.benson@orchidcap.com>, Penwell Assessors <assessor@penwell.com>
Date: 2027-12-20T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: targeted SDLC artifacts - PR hardening & CI exceptions

Tessa / Irene / Laura / Penwell team —

I've uploaded the requested materials to the Drive folder and attached a small manifest (sample_prs_sanitized.zip contains three PRs: PR-4921.txt, PR-5010.txt, PR-5123.txt). Each PR file includes: commit summary, reviewer comments (timestamps + reviewer handle), CI check outputs, and linked ticket references.

Redaction note: we removed code blocks tagged INTERNAL-ALGO and replaced them with explanatory placeholders so you can verify the review process without exposing IP. The redaction log is in the Drive folder (redaction_log_20271220.md).

Irene, the KMS rotation CSV is also uploaded (secret_rotation_202711_report.xlsx) and includes rotation timestamps and operator email (no secret values). For the CI exception log I included an additional column "approver_doc" linking to the change_approval_audit_trail.pdf pages that show the approval snippet.

Next steps: if Penwell needs verbatim audit records (they will require a data-sharing addendum), Laura let us know and we can schedule a secured transfer.

--
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Platform Security
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
